title: Editor E0 task 12b, link list slice: a one-column builder on the node store for the Spotlight
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. components/entity-blocks/node-link-list-builder.tsx: NodeLinkListBuilder is EntityPageBuilder with maxColumns=1 for the node store. Each placed node is a strip (BlockPill) in a list, one node per one-column row, with up/down as a row move, hide, bench, delete, and an Add a block row that adds a new node of each palette type not at its cap or puts a benched node back. The palette is a prop (the Spotlight's), the settings panel edits text itself (the Spotlight preview carries no slug), and the page's inline editors are never turned on. Dormant: nothing mounts it until LIVE-1054.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const e=fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/node-link-list-builder.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!e.includes('useNodeLayout')||!e.includes('moveNodeRow'))bad.push('not on the node store');if(/Record<string/.test(e))bad.push('a Record keyed by a node id');if(e.includes('setSpaceEditMode'))bad.push('turns the page editors on');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1053: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the link list leaves the node store, keys a Record by node id, or turns on the page's inline editors. Behavior is node-link-list-builder.test.tsx.
